outcome_summary: Implemented the `_infer_project_root()` helper in `orchestrator/src/cli.py` so that the orchestrator correctly infers the target project root from the plan path when `--project-path` is not provided. The function uses the established `parents[3]` convention with a `docs/agents/plans/` sanity check and falls back gracefully to `config.workspace_root`. All acceptance criteria were met and all tests pass.
